pages.text: There was a small cat named Mimi. She was afraid of the dark.
One night, her ball rolled under the bed. The room was very dark.
Mimi was brave. She walked slowly into the dark room.
She found her ball! She was so happy and proud.
Sam found a big red apple on the tree.
His friend Lily was hungry. She had no food.
Sam cut the apple in half and gave one half to Lily.
They ate together and were both happy.
It rained all morning. The flowers were happy.
The sun came out after the rain. Everything was bright.
A beautiful rainbow appeared in the sky.
The children ran outside to play in the puddles.
Tom the rabbit and Ben the bear were best friends.
One day, Ben hurt his paw and could not walk.
Tom brought him food and sat with him every day.
Ben got better. He said: You are my best friend forever!

comprehensionQuestions.question: Who helped Ben when he was hurt?

pages.text: Maya found a tiny seed in the park.
She planted it in her garden and watered it every day.
Slowly, a beautiful flower grew tall and bright.
Maya learned that with care, small things become wonderful.
Ali and his dad went to the zoo on a sunny day.
They saw a tall giraffe eating leaves from a tree.
Then they saw a funny penguin sliding on the ice.
Ali said: I love animals! Can we come back tomorrow?
